notes.title: All Controller Updated - 更多控制器更新
notes.content:
[h1]Happy News Here: More Controllers You need[/h1]
[u]Keyboard Controller:[/u]
←  :    Left Move
→  :    Right Move
 ↑  :    Entering to a stage
Q  :    Hold the button to adjust the viewer screen
 D :    Basic Attack, hold the button to attack constantly
 S :    Jump
 A :    Hold the button to accelerate 
Enter: Main Menu option selected and press Enter button 
ESC:  If you are in the selecting world room or in the selecting mode room, press ESC you can go back to "Main Menu".
Wall Sliding: Jump to the wall, and then hold the key of  "←" or "→" with the same direction as the wall, then the character will slide the wall slowly.
Wall climbing: Constantly press "Jump" button while sliding on the wall. 

[u]Joystick Support: PS4 DUALSHOCK 4 Controller: [/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35502220/db6084fcd269f77086a7adc0163f7fcde943800f.png[/img]


Direction Button ←  :    Left Move
Direction Button →  :    Right Move
Direction Button  ↑   :    Entering to a stage
L2 Button                 :    Hold the button to adjust the viewer screen
Square Button         :    Basic Attack, hold the button to attack constantly
Cross Button           :    Jump
L1 Button                :    Hold the button to accelerate 
Options.                   : Main Menu option selected and press Options button before entering next menu.
Share Button           :    If you are in the selecting world room or in the selecting mode room, press Share Button you can go back to "Main Menu".

[u]Joystick Support: XBox 360, XBox One Controller[/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35502220/ff9aa9631e64c75bce086355d187f3b079e88396.jpg[/img]

Direction Button ← : Left Move
Direction Button → : Right Move
Direction Button ↑ : Entering to a stage
LT Button : Hold the button to adjust the viewer screen
Cross Button : Basic Attack, hold the button to attack constantly
A Button : Jump
LB Button : Hold the button to accelerate 
Start Button : In Main Menu what you selected before pressing the Options button and then entering the next menu.
Back Button : If you are in the selecting world room or in the selecting mode room, press Back Button you can go back to "Main Menu".

Actually, you can use a lot of different joysticks but must need the same as PS 4 or XBox One button position.


Notice: We have a lot of buttons used in the future, that's why we can't use other buttons.


[u]鍵盤操作[/u]
[b]
←  :  左 移動
→  :  右 移動
 ↑  :   進入傳送點
 Q  :   按住不放可下移玩家視角
 D  :   基本攻擊，按住可連射
 S  :   跳躍
 A  :   按住不放可加速角色移動
Enter: 在主選單選完選項，再按Enter進入下一個選單
ESC：如果您在選擇世界房間或選擇模式房間，按ESC鍵可以返回“主菜單”。
滑牆 : 在空中碰觸牆壁並按住對應牆壁方向的 "←" or "→" 鍵不放，可抓住牆壁緩緩滑落。
爬牆 : 在滑牆的動作中連續按下 "跳躍" 鍵。

[u]控制器支援: PS4 DUALSHOCK 4 控制器[/u]
Direction Button ←  :    左 移動
Direction Button →  :    右 移動
Direction Button  ↑   :    進入傳送點
L2 Button                 :    按住不放可下移玩家視角
Square Button          :   基本攻擊，按住可連射
Cross Button            :    跳躍
L1 Button                 :    按住不放可加速角色移動
Options.                   :    在主選單選完選項，再按Options進入下一個選單
Share Button          ： 如果您在選擇世界房間或選擇模式房間，按Share鍵可以返回“主菜單”。

[u]控制器支援: 控制器支援: XBox 360, XBox One 控制器[/u]
Direction Button ← : 左 移動
Direction Button → : 右 移動
Direction Button ↑ : 進入傳送點
LT Button : 按住不放可下移玩家視角
Cross Button : 基本攻擊，按住可連射
A Button : 跳躍
LB Button : 按住不放可加速角色移動
Start Button : 在主選單選完選項，再按Start進入下一個選單
Back Button ： 如果您在選擇世界房間或選擇模式房間，按Back鍵可以返回“主菜單”。

實際上，您可以使用許多不同的操縱桿，但必須與PS 4或XBox One按鈕位置相同。

注意：我們將來會使用很多按鈕，所以我們暫時不會使用其他按鈕。

notes.title: About this game content development 關於遊戲內容的開發
notes.content:
Hi~! Guys~~!!
In general, our game will be updated every one to two weeks.
Just in case, we don't want to let players feel bored on our game, so we will show players every week for updating. As developers who are in Bastdre Studio, we will do as best as we can for updating our game ASAP.

We know our game content is really barely less because we have understaffed. That's why we need you guys to support and stay tuned to our development in Early Access.

Here are a few plans of ours in future development:
In our game, we will add more main characters for the player to select. Maybe more than 15 main characters. Every main character has their own different playable style. It will look like ARPG in the future. And also provide sub-weapons Picked-Up, sub-ability added, and more option player can choose. We will provide "Multiple-Player (2~4 Players for maximum)", and "Co-op".

Of course, we will have more "Bosses" and more than "200 Enemies" in the future.
Open more worlds and more plenty of playable mode.
"File Data Save System" will be released in the future.

If you found some places or buttons that you can’t enter, they aren’t bugs, they are still developed. So, wait for us.

Joystick Controller will also be released recently.



Please, stay tuned to our game content updates.
We won't let you guys disappointed.



各位玩家們好，一般來說，我們的遊戲每隔一到兩週會更新一次。
為了以防萬一，我們不想讓玩家對我們的遊戲感到厭倦，所以我們會每周向玩家展示更新。 作為Bastdre Studio的開發人員，我們將盡最大努力盡快更新我們的遊戲。

我們知道我們的遊戲內容實際上幾乎沒有，因為我們人手目前不足。 然而我們工作室需要您的支持並繼續關注我們的發展，請各位玩家持續的關注我們的遊戲。

以下是我們未來發展的一些計劃：
在我們的遊戲中，我們將添加更多主要角色供玩家選擇。 也許超過15個主角。 每個主角都有自己不同的可玩風格。 它將來會像ARPG一樣。 並且還提供可撿的副武器，也可以擁有輔助性能力的效果，以及更多選項讓玩家自由的做選擇。 我們之後將會提供“多人遊戲（最多2~4個玩家）"。

當然，我們將來也會有更多的“頭目”和超過“200個敵人”。
打開更多世界和更多豐富遊戲的玩法。
"遊戲存檔"將會在之後發布。

如果你們發現到有些地方或按鈕不能進去，那些不是Bug，而是目前還在製作當中，敬請期待呦~~!!!
(>^ω^<)

操縱桿控制器最近也還在製作中，很快就會發布的，請多多關注我們的遊戲內容更新呀~!!
我們不會讓你們失望的呦~!!
